entries.reason: Only logo was missing. Checked Wikipedia: Trent_University_Logo.svg exists solely as a non-free/fair-use file on en.wikipedia (returns 404 on Wikimedia Commons, confirming it is not freely licensed there). Checked the official site's Communications & Enrolment 'Logos for Download' page: it explicitly requires emailing webrequest@trentu.ca with a usage justification before any logo file is released - an explicit written-permission gate per the hold criteria. No Commons-licensed alternative exists. Remains held.
